title: OpenWorldLib: A Unified Codebase and Definition of Advanced World Models
task: Unified inference framework for world models
key_results: Standardized definition and categorization of world model capabilities; integrated framework enabling efficient model reuse
comments: Provides valuable infrastructure but is primarily a systems contribution without novel algorithmic or empirical breakthroughs.

title: MinerU2.5-Pro: Pushing the Limits of Data-Centric Document Parsing at Scale
task: Data-centric document parsing at scale
key_results: 95.69% on OmniDocBench v1.6 (+2.71pp over same-architecture baseline), 65.5M training samples via data engineering alone with fixed 1.2B architecture
comments: Demonstrates that training data quality and scale can outweigh architectural innovation; notable for achieving SOTA without model changes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Performance bottlenecks stem from training data deficiencies rather than architecture
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via SOTA results from data engineering alone

title: LIBERO-Para: A Diagnostic Benchmark and Metrics for Paraphrase Robustness in VLA Models
task: Paraphrase robustness evaluation for VLA models
key_results: 22-52pp performance degradation under paraphrasing across 0.6B-7.5B models; 80-96% of failures from planning-level trajectory divergence; PRIDE metric quantifies difficulty via semantic/syntactic factors
comments: Reveals critical gap in VLA semantic grounding; PRIDE metric provides fine-grained difficulty assessment beyond binary success.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Paraphrasing disrupts task identification more than execution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 80-96% of failures are trajectory divergence, not execution errors

title: TriAttention: Efficient Long Reasoning with Trigonometric KV Compression
task: KV cache compression for extended reasoning
key_results: 2.5x throughput improvement or 10.7x KV memory reduction on AIME25 32K-token generation while matching full attention accuracy; baselines achieve only ~50% accuracy at same efficiency
comments: Novel trigonometric approach to understanding Q/K concentration is elegant; enables practical deployment of long-context reasoning on consumer hardware.

hypotheses.result: Confirmed; enables stable key importance estimation

title: Adam's Law: Textual Frequency Law on Large Language Models
task: Textual frequency optimization for LLM prompting and fine-tuning
key_results: Textual Frequency Law (TFL) framework effective on math reasoning, MT, commonsense reasoning, tool-calling; Curriculum Textual Frequency Training outperforms baselines
comments: Proposes underexplored dimension (sentence-level frequency); however, evaluation is limited to in-house dataset and lacks comparison with simpler baselines.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Frequent textual expressions improve LLM performance for both prompting and fine-tuning
hypotheses.result: Supported by experiments on TFPD dataset

title: AURA: Always-On Understanding and Real-Time Assistance via Video Streams
task: Real-time streaming video understanding and interaction
key_results: State-of-the-art on streaming benchmarks; 2 FPS real-time demo on two 80G GPUs with ASR/TTS integration
comments: Strong system for practical deployment; contributions span context management, training objectives, and inference optimization rather than novel reasoning approaches.

task: Fine-grained image spatial editing benchmark and model
key_results: SpatialEdit-16B outperforms prior methods on spatial manipulation; synthetic dataset SpatialEdit-500k provides precise ground-truth transformations; benchmark jointly measures perceptual plausibility and geometric fidelity
comments: Addresses data bottleneck for spatial editing through controllable synthesis; useful benchmark but incremental on architectural front.

task: File-system grounded agent personalization and memory

comments: ClawArena captures real-world complexity (multi-source conflicts, dynamic updates, implicit personalization); fills important benchmark gap.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Belief revision difficulty depends on update design strategy rather than update presence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via scenario analysis

task: Unified on-policy RL framework combining reward-aligned and logit-level supervision

comments: Sample routing elegantly unifies two complementary objectives; entropy-aware weighting addresses instability without ad-hoc hyperparameters.

task: Code generation via self-execution simulation

comments: Elegant framework addressing non-uniqueness via fractal scaling laws; scalable alternative to core-based methods where lab data unavailable.

model_io.model: Dipole sonic log + fractal pore model + BEM elastic simulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fractal pore populations constrained by scaling laws mitigate non-uniqueness

title: Investigation and analysis of the impact of fibre mixing on the strength of nonwoven fabrics produced using double-drum carding machines
task: Investigate fiber mixing quality and nonwoven strength in double-drum carding via mathematical modeling
key_results: Fiber delay time 1.40–1.99 s; circulation path length 16.9–17.0 m (carder 1) vs. 20.5–26.4 m (carder 2); second carder shows more intensive longitudinal mixing; correlation with final fabric strength documented
comments: Mathematical models of carding dynamics (delay time, path length) relate process parameters to product quality; industrial validation strengthens textile engineering foundations.

model_io.model: Carding dynamics model: fiber delay time + circulation path length (derived from carder geometry and process parameters)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Longer circulation path length increases fiber mixing homogeneity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; carder 2 (longer path) produces stronger nonwovens

title: All-optical control of second-harmonic generation in β-BaB2O4 via coherent, terahertz-driven acentric lattice displacement
task: Control second-harmonic generation via THz-driven lattice displacement
key_results: ~30% modulation of phase-matched SHG in β-BaB₂O₄ via resonant THz-phonon coupling; mechanism identified as index ellipsoid modification
comments: Novel all-optical control mechanism but efficiency and scalability to other materials unclear.

inputs: THz pump pulse (resonant with phonon mode)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Resonant THz-driven lattice deformation modulates nonlinear phase-matching via index ellipsoid changes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ~30% SHG modulation achieved; mechanism validated as refraction index modification

title: Topology-guided rotational dynamics of magnetic soliton assemblies under pulsed current
task: Study current-driven rotational dynamics of topological spin textures
key_results: Skyrmions and antiskyrmions rotate in opposite directions dictated by topological charge; rotation sense independent of current direction; angular velocity decreases away from sample edge
comments: LTEM-based investigation is valuable but theoretical understanding of boundary effects could be strengthened.

model_io.model: Ferromagnetic thin film with skyrmion/antiskyrmion textures

hypotheses.hypothesis: Topological charge determines rotation direction; boundary-induced confining potential and gyrotropic forces govern angular velocity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; rotation sense unaffected by current direction; boundary effects reduce angular velocity

title: Spectral signature of periodic modulation and shifting of pseudogap state in moiré system
task: Characterize pseudogap state modulation in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene
key_results: Gate-tunable pseudogap with moiré-scale spatial modulation; nematic gap distribution at certain dopings; wave-like pseudogap feature identified
comments: STM-based local spectroscopy provides unprecedented detail but interpretation of pseudogap nature and connection to superconductivity remains open.

model_io.model: Spectroscopic imaging STM on magic-angle TBG

hypotheses.hypothesis: Pseudogap exhibits moiré-scale spatial modulation and spontaneous symmetry breaking sensitive to filling and gate tuning

title: Deuterated perovskite for room temperature spin device
task: Enable room-temperature spin transport in perovskites via isotope engineering
key_results: Deuteration (CD₃ND₃PbI₃) increases spin lifetime 2.6× and magnetocurrent to 17.5% at room temperature; suppresses hyperfine interactions
comments: Innovative isotope engineering approach with clear mechanism but scalability to commercial perovskite devices requires device optimization.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deuterium substitution suppresses hyperfine interactions, extending spin lifetime and enabling room-temperature magnetocurrent
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 2.6-fold lifetime increase and 17.5% MC ratio achieved; spin photovoltaic effect observed

title: Koopmans-compliant density functional framework for polaron self-trapping in titanate oxides
task: Model polaron self-trapping in titanate oxides using Koopmans-compliant DFT
key_results: Consistent polaron formation energies across functionals (PBEsol, SCAN, LAK, HSE06); SIC correction restores correct rhombohedral phase stability in BaTiO₃
comments: Rigorous methodological comparison but computational cost and applicability to larger systems limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Enforcing generalized Koopmans condition yields consistent small-polaron energetics across functionals
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; SIC corrections critical for correct phase prediction in BaTiO₃

title: Metamaterials that learn to change shape
task: Enable metamaterials to learn complex shape-changing responses
key_results: Metamaterials learn reciprocity-breaking and multistable shape changes; demonstrated reflex gripping and locomotion
comments: Novel integration of machine learning with physical material design, though scalability and energy efficiency of learning mechanism warrant further study.

model_io.model: Adaptive metamaterial with learnable local stiffnesses

hypotheses.hypothesis: Contrastive learning can update internal degrees of freedom to achieve target shape changes sequentially

title: Double-edged role of interactions in superconducting twisted bilayer graphene
task: Investigate role of electronic interactions in twisted bilayer graphene superconductivity
key_results: Superconductivity suppressed by increasing substrate dielectric constant; Coulomb screening plays dual-edged role in pairing; phonon contribution confirmed
comments: Elegant experimental design isolating interaction effects but mechanism unification across magic-angle and large-angle regimes incomplete.

model_io.model: Twisted bilayer graphene on SrTiO₃ substrate with variable dielectric constant

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coulomb interactions screened by plasmons and phonons are essential for superconducting pairing in TBG; increased screening suppresses Tc
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; steady suppression and extinction of superconductivity with rising dielectric constant observed

title: Tunable dual-band THz metamaterial absorber with regression-learning-enabled numerical redesign
task: Optimize THz metamaterial absorber design via machine learning
key_results: Dual-band absorber with ~90% absorption at 1.44 and 4.24 THz; inverse design via regression models validated by full-wave simulation
comments: Data-driven approach reduces simulation cost but regression model generalization to out-of-distribution geometries is not discussed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Inverse ML design predictions match full-wave simulation results for THz absorber geometry
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with low percentage errors; tunability demonstrated for user-specified resonances and absorption

task: Enhance up-conversion photoluminescence via plasmonic gold dendrites

key_results: Enhanced ground state preparation accuracy at fixed gate budget; framework proven to increase performance across multiple ansatz families
comments: Addresses a fundamental VQA limitation but applicability to near-term devices with noise requires empirical validation.
